This is a simple one (i'm not much of a cook) but find it delicious!

Ingredients:

  • 1 pizza base
  • Tomato puree
  • Oregano
  • Cheddar cheese
  • Olive Oil

Put your pizza base on a baking tray. Spread a thin layer of olive oil on the top surface. Smear some tomato puree onto the base with the bottom of a spoon (make sure it's covered). Cover it with grated cheddar cheese. Sprinkle some oregano on top.

Cook for 12-14 minutes on 180 degrees (fan oven).

The article states "The original Americans came from Siberia in a single wave no more than 23,000 years ago, at the height of the last Ice Age, and apparently hung out in the north - perhaps for thousands of years - before spreading in two distinct populations throughout North and -South America, according to a new genomic analysis." The data presented does not support this conclusion. The data supports the conclusion that all a small sample of people distributed over a large area, and those of a small sample of individuals sampled over the last 6000 years all came from a wave of migration that occured no more than 23,000 years ago.
